summary: GT Biopharma filed an 8-K reporting a first amendment to a September 14, 2026 securities purchase agreement for a private placement of Series M 10% convertible preferred stock and warrants. The amendment added a new purchaser and increased the offering by 333.333 preferred shares, bringing the aggregate stated value to $8,611,111.11 and the purchase price to $7,750,000. Proceeds are expected for general corporate purposes. The filing also covers unregistered sales, rights modifications, and charter amendments. The structural overhang from conversion and warrant dilution and future resale registration timing are the key risk-arb watch items.
